name: Phone Connect help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Phone Connect plugin.
author: Brett

entries.title: Phone Connect settings
entries.text: Pair the Phone Connect app, see and revoke paired phones, and switch each phone feature on or off.

entries.title: New code
entries.text: Makes a new one-time pairing code (10 minutes, single use) and cancels the old one. Type it in the Phone Connect app; your own axHub sign-in there claims it.

entries.title: Cancel code
entries.text: Cancels the pending pairing code so nobody can claim it.

entries.title: Copy code
entries.text: Copies the pairing code so you can paste it into the Phone Connect app.

entries.title: Watch (keep the link open)
entries.text: Keeps the phone's background link to the console open (a foreground service), so pushes, approvals and pages arrive at once.

entries.title: Ring on new approvals
entries.text: Rings the phone when a new approval or veto countdown arrives.

entries.title: Pages it may open
entries.text: Which pages the console and agents may open on this phone: only the console, the console plus listed sites, or any https site.

entries.title: Sites (comma separated)
entries.text: The extra sites this phone may open when the policy is "The console + these sites": host names like github.com.

entries.title: Save sites
entries.text: Saves the site list for this phone's url policy.

entries.title: Layout of this tab
entries.text: How this tab is laid out: four tabs, one page with every section, or the paired phone on top with Features and Activity as tabs below.
